method: Viewed every original individual PNG for pages 1–10 using view_image; no contact sheet and no reuse of prior-render visual approval.

pages.observations: Title, abstract, keyword line and introduction remain legible and inside page margins. Updated KRAS figures are readable. No body/footer collision or cropped glyphs.
Introduction continuation and methods/2.1 headings with complete following paragraphs. No clipping or overlap. Bottom whitespace keeps Figure 1 together on following page.
Figure 1 panels a–d, all English figure labels and complete Chinese caption fit. Caption and subsequent data-description text are separated. No cropped panel or text overlap.
Sections 2.2/2.3 and equations (1)/(2) render completely. Radicals, sum limits, equation numbers and inline Greek notation are readable; no equation/paragraph collision.
Encoding and training descriptions, equations (3)/(4), optimizer parameters and scientific notation are all legible. Display equations remain inside margins and do not collide with text.
Sections 2.5/2.6 with family-split and baseline details fit cleanly. No cropped line or overflow near footer. Mathematical units remain legible.

Section 2.7 updated CBP/KIX identity and KRAS methods text are readable. KIX construct numbering, KRAS sequences, HLA notation and replicate description fit within margins. Final KRAS paragraph continues normally onto page 8; no clipped continuation.

KRAS difference-SEM continuation, expanded ubiquitin–EDD UBA wording, section 2.8 and equation (5) are complete. Sum limits and F-star/log notation are visible. Added background slightly lengthens text but bottom line remains clear and separate from page number.

Low-relative-free-energy and entropy-method continuation, results heading and 3.1 introductory paragraph remain readable. No overlap or missing content; whitespace keeps Table 1 intact on following page.

Table 1 title, full grouped three-line table, all method/numeric rows, table note and three following result paragraphs fit on one page. Columns align; no cropped cell, detached header, caption collision or overflow.

scope: Visual layout QA of pages 1–10 only, linked to the specified v42 document hash.
